headline: The chain shows 30 wallets paying 6.25 ETH into this early Forsage contract and 14 wallets receiving 6.05 ETH from it, with 3.2% kept by the contract. It does not show who ran it or why.

figures.label: Share kept
figures.note: by the contract, of what it received

checks.claim: A Forsage founder said in a video, as quoted in the SEC complaint: "Here everyone decides for themselves when to withdraw, hold, no hold, and so on."
checks.evidence: Payouts were made in 1 of the 1 days that had payments in. 119 payouts were sent to 14 wallets.

checks.claim: A Forsage founder said in an interview, as quoted in the SEC complaint: "Forsage does not accumulate funds; its balance is always zero."
checks.evidence: The tests in this version ask whether the contract holds funds, not whether it passes them on, so they make no finding on this statement.

tests.title: Money in and out
tests.summary: 92 payments from 30 wallets brought in 6.25 ETH. 119 payouts to 14 wallets sent out 6.05 ETH, so the contract kept 3.2% of what it received.

tests.title: Withdrawals by day
tests.summary: Payouts were made in 1 of the 1 days that had payments in.

tests.title: Who the money depends on
tests.summary: The five largest recipients received 90.5% of payouts, and the five largest payers supplied 34.4% of payments in.

tests.title: Where payouts came from
tests.summary: This version does not test where payouts came from, so it makes no finding on it.
